details.hoursNote: 90 seats; counter, tatami/sunken seating and private rooms. No on-site parking; heated-tobacco smoking in designated areas. Cards and PayPay accepted; e-money not accepted. ¥440 appetizer charge; charge tax basis not separately stated. Confirm room and holiday hours when booking. Sashimi¥990 is per serving, minimum two servings for parties of two or more. The group course needs at least six adults, prior consultation for nine or more and for children; all guests enter together and same-day headcount changes are unavailable. Its duration fields conflict: title up tofive hours versus 210-minute stay; confirm before booking. Current¥299 beer/highball/sour prices are ordinary menu rates; no dated promotion inferred.

researchNotes: Two October19Osaka branches, independently checked by English and Japanese names locally and in production. Exact branch source URLs and full profiles validated before writes; no existing pins updated. Osaka Just opened should reach30while all Coming soon cells and Fukuoka Just opened remain below target.

Sakigake original branch openingOctober19matches managed listing and local launch report. Daily hours and last orders retained, including holiday/eve alternatives; avoid copying a single generic midnight closing to all days. Appetizer charge¥440tax basis not stated. Customer phone unpublished in managed branch; recruitment telephone is not substituted.

Sakigake44food rows expanded to50priced portions, preserving ordinary/large bonito and chicken, mackerel1–2/3–4portions, two rice-ball flavors and three clay-pot flavors. Sashimi¥990per serving and minimumtwo for parties2+retained. Hoppy naka/soto refills distinguished.¥299drinks have no verified promotion window and are ordinary menu prices.

Sakigake group course: minimumsix adults, groupsnine or more need inquiry, children¥4000by consultation, self-service drinks, no same-day headcount change. Current title up tofive hours conflicts with210-minute stay field; no unlimited stay or exact duration promised. Individual sake list is variable; drinks grouped with included course menu, not assumed ordinary menu pricing.

Hitotsubu is a second, tonkatsu-specific branch; not a reset of the original Japanese restaurant. Exact new branch openingOctober19, phone and¥5900/¥8900courses corroborated. Dishes transcribed from exact course pages; origins are examples. Duplicate translated Loin in dinner list consolidated without inventing anothercut. Actual drink prices and lunch curry supplement remain unpublished after ordinary menu/drink tabs, course pages, TableCheck, operator Instagram and gallery checks.

Both operatorInstagram accounts linked and fetched, but no public post content exposed. Exact operator-managed Tabelog branch galleries inspected instead; twelve chosen credited photos hosted in Azure. No inferred dish/brand from unlabelled photo, no old original-restaurant gallery used for Hitotsubu.

AFRO managed branch openingOctober19conflicts with local report of October16–24preopening; latest web article changed from its cached opening snippet. Preserve both findings and hold until operator establishes first service. Exact menu/gallery gathered but noAFROpin created.
